name: Tax Deduction Comparision
query:
SELECT 
    ss.gross_pay AS "Gross Pay",

    MAX(CASE WHEN ss.salary_structure = 'Old Tax Regime' 
             THEN ss.total_deduction END) AS "Old Tax Regime",

    MAX(CASE WHEN ss.salary_structure = 'New Tax Regime' 
             THEN ss.total_deduction END) AS "New Tax Regime"

FROM `tabSalary Slip` ss
WHERE ss.docstatus = 1
GROUP BY ss.gross_pay
HAVING 
    MAX(CASE WHEN ss.salary_structure = 'Old Tax Regime' THEN 1 END) = 1
    AND MAX(CASE WHEN ss.salary_structure = 'New Tax Regime' THEN 1 END) = 1
ORDER BY ss.gross_pay;
